purpose: Per-chapter terrain/backdrop override byte for the battle combat-cinematic and AoE-spell-cast backdrop selection, indexed by current chapter id.
logic_summary: Read-only uint8[30]. Each reader does MOVZX reg, byte ptr [current_chapter_id + 0x52363] (unsigned byte, stride 1). The override applies to flying/lifted status-immune classes whose under-foot tile attribute is wrong: when the chapter entry is non-zero it supplies the terrain/backdrop index; when 0 the readers fall back to the live under-foot tile attribute. 4 reader sites, no writers. Values: 3 for chapters where the default override applies, 0 for chapters that fall back (0-indexed entries 24,25,26,28,29 are 0; entry 27 is 3; all others 3).
element_semantics: One byte per chapter (indexed by 0-based chapter id 0..29 = chapters 1..30). Value is a terrain/backdrop override code: 3 = use the default per-chapter override for the combat/spell cinematic backdrop; 0 = no override, fall back to the live under-foot tile attribute.
